marking_points.text: Selects x = vt + at^2 as the homogeneous equation

option_feedback.A: The term vt has unit m, but at has unit m s^-1, so those terms cannot be added to give x.
option_feedback.B: The term v/t has unit m s^-2 and at has unit m s^-1, so neither term has the unit m of x.
option_feedback.C: Correct. Both vt and at^2 reduce to m, matching the unit of x.
option_feedback.D: The term vt^2 has unit m s, while at^2 has unit m, so the right-hand terms do not match.

option_feedback.A: Correct. (kg m^-3)(m^2)(m^2 s^-2) simplifies to kg m s^-2, so C is dimensionless.

option_feedback.C: An inverse second would change the time power to s^-3, which does not match force.

questions.unit_policy: Final units must be stated entirely in SI base units.
